title: Melody's Elytras
description: The ultimate elytra pack (still being worked on).
body:
A pack featuring many different types of wings as elytras.

![melodys elytras monarch butterfly wings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e878893642f60d9789b142d53fc81306e377f5a0.png)

This pack is currently in beta and slowly being worked on (meaning you might come across some texture issues), make sure to join my discord and follow my socials to keep up with updates!

 [IMPORTANT]

> This pack needs Optifine OR (EMF & ETF).
> This pack is still in beta so there might be issues!
> You need to change the name of the elytras for it to work.
> I don't know which versions this pack works on yet.

Please read the README.md file.

![melodys elytra white angel wings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2329298ed04b34d337d0b88c442fa38f62cb675c_0.webp)
